info.title: Sup3API Assets API
info.description:
Independent asynchronous 3D asset API. Billing uses provider-native credits at multiplier 1, not Sub2API USD wallet debits. Operator must allowlist users. Assets are isolated by owner AND API key. No third-party Studio OAuth or session credentials are used.

Provider options (wrong-operation options are rejected):
Tripo generation: geometry_quality (standard/detailed), smart_low_poly, generate_parts, model_seed, auto_size; textured generation: texture_quality (standard/detailed/extreme; fast requires v3.5), texture_version (v3.5-20260815), texture_seed; text generation: image_seed, negative_prompt. Retexture: texture_quality (fast/standard/detailed/extreme). Rig: rig_type, spec (tripo/mixamo). Animate: animation_in_place.
Meshy generation: geometry_resolution (standard/2k/4k; Ultra requires meshy-7.1), moderation. Text with texture: texture_prompt. Rig: height_meters.

Tripo image inputs are public HTTPS URLs. Meshy also supports base64 PNG/JPEG data URIs (10 MiB decoded/image, 16384 pixels per side; 16 MiB JSON request limit). Tripo multiview order is [front,left,back,right] with front and at least one other view. Meshy uses 1–4 URLs. Cross-provider job references and binary file uploads are not implemented. Explicit native field envelopes are supported for the documented subset. Per-step provider_result preserves upstream task JSON including expiring provider URLs; use authenticated artifact URLs for durable delivery.

Native compatibility: /providers/meshy and /providers/tripo/v3 preserve provider requests and responses for the explicitly listed endpoints. Native tasks are scoped to owner + gateway key + provider credential, separate from unified jobs; files remain provider-managed. No lists, uploads, file tokens, webhooks, historical task import or unlisted endpoints/query parameters. Native credits bypass the LLM wallet. Optional Idempotency-Key replays persisted status/body; uncertain submissions require operator reconciliation.
Unified output requirements are verified after delivery; unmet requirements can occur after provider charges. No automatic conversion. See /docs/compatibility and /docs/output.

bearerAuth.description: Sub2API API key, not a provider API key

items.description: Public HTTPS image URL; Meshy additionally accepts validated PNG/JPEG base64 data URI.

target_faces.description: Meshy approximate target; not a bound.

max_faces.description: Tripo upper bound; not a target.

items.description: Provider-native preset name or decimal action ID.

formats.description: Legacy alias of output.formats. Conflicting values are rejected; selectable direct formats depend on provider/operation/topology.

usd.description: Present for Tripo only; absent when a universal conversion is not verified.

role.description: Open role namespace: model, geometry, materials, texture.*, skeleton, skin_weights, animations, animation, preview.

url.description: Relative authenticated gateway URL; no upstream signed URL.

provider_result.description: Full upstream task query JSON for this step. May contain expiring CDN URLs; not present on historical jobs until refreshed.

models_by_operation.description: Supported model versions for each operation; empty array means omit model.

native_api.description: base_url, create_paths, task_query, delete, sse, list, file_upload, webhooks, historical_tasks, optional_idempotency, response, billing, artifact_retention.

operation_details.description: Per-operation models, selectable_output_formats, format_conditions, extension_fields with types/enums and constraints. Validate exact combinations via quotes.

model.description: Version pinned by operation. Meshy rig/animate and Tripo animate omit model.

provider_options.description: Strict operation-specific allowlist; see ProviderOptions documentation below.

extensions.description: Only selected provider namespace is accepted; validated known options. Unknown options or conflicts with provider_options are rejected. Discover fields via operation_details.extension_fields.

input_format.description: Must match provider. Only explicitly mapped fields are accepted.

payload.description: Tripo V3 or Meshy field subset; see /docs/native. Provider task references must be gateway job_ IDs. Unsupported fields are rejected; native Meshy text mode=preview performs geometry-only preview.

formats.description: Required directly generated formats; support depends on provider, operation and topology. No automatic conversion.

required_components.description: Verified after GLB extraction; requires GLB. Skeleton/weights require rig or animate; animations require animate.

ProviderNativePayload.description: Provider JSON; no unified envelope or defaults. Resource references require ownership; callbacks/file tokens are unsupported. Other fields are preserved and validated upstream.

ProviderNativeResponse.description: Unmodified provider JSON. Meshy create returns result task ID; Tripo create returns code and data.task_id. Unknown fields retained.
